owner: owner review of S93, verbatim in .claude/skills/pee-guided-learning/references/owner-review-s93-2026-10-20.md
writtenBefore: any model is run in S94
question: Given the Stage 1 and Stage 2 baselines, does a small local instruction model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, S77 full-sequence readout) recognise concept identities better when it receives PEE's structured scientific information than with the S76 input, and does any gain justify its cost?
shadowOnly: scripts/r3-semantic/validate.py runs in a separate virtual environment outside the repositories; weights in a cache outside the repositories; nothing it produces enters the store, links or rankings; no paid API, no fine-tuning, no production dependency

arms.llmS76: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, S76 input (sentence, phrase, concept name, kind, description), LLM_READOUT=seq
arms.llmStruct: the same model and readout, plus PEE's structured information per pair (phrase semantic type and quantity typing; concept quantity typing and up to five graph relations; type compatibility, quantity check, lexical anchor, name coverage, distributional relatedness labelled as not identity)
arms.llm05Struct: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with the structured input, for cost information only, on the S76 transfer examples

decisionRule: the S76 frozen rule, unchanged: identity when p(exact)+p(close) >= 0.5 and not below the hierarchical, related or none mass, with the semantic-type gate; a mention is aligned only to a unique identity candidate. Also reported without the gate

material.transfer: the S76 frozen transfer examples (120 mentions, 396 candidates, 14 identities): the same examples as S76, as the owner asked; examined once in S76
material.s94: the new sealed reference of Stage 2 (120 mentions, 622 candidates, 11 identities); used once by the Stage 2 arms, never by a model

costs: load time, seconds per pair, maximum resident memory, threads (4 CPU threads)
stopRule: if llmStruct does not recover more correct identities than the best non-generative arm (lexical identifier, type gate, Stage 2 hybrid) on both sets without more related-to-identity promotions, the model is not justified; no further prompt tuning
